newsitem.title: UK: Clarke says UK PPI data "staggeringly low".
newsitem.headline: Clarke says UK PPI data "staggeringly low".

text.p: Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke said UK producer price data for January released on Monday were "staggeringly low."
"As I was driving to work this morning the producer price data were released, which were staggeringly low," he told reporters after a conference in London.
Clarke also noted that car registration figures had given a very good showing in January.
Although recent official figures showed retail sales fell 0.8 percent in December, Clarke said: "Retailers had a good Christmas in 1996, some had an exceptional Christmas."
"Unemployment has fallen to its lowest for almost six years and I believe has a good way further to fall before we start to see shortages putting upward pressure on wages and prices," he added.
